decisions.reason: The message independently selects the basket-weave option and reference detailing, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records those changes; no additional or edited Event is needed.
Selecting a Zebra artwork option and reducing its yellow/gold tone does not change production readiness, CMYK mode, or seamless-repeat file requirements.
The source message only changes the Zebra and basket-weave designs and does not modify the terracotta block-colour pareo.
The request for a less yellow/gold Zebra palette is specific to the Zebra print and does not alter the mustard block-colour pareo.
The Zebra palette adjustment changes artwork colour direction but does not alter the established Pantone, visual-approximation, ICC-profile, or fabric calibration process.
